headline: Meta says Muse has over 10 million users, confirming Sensor Tower estimates
body: Meta said on its third-quarter earnings call that Muse, its AI app, has more than 10 million users. Zuckerberg said about 25% of people who set up Muse now use it daily, and that over a quarter of engaged users who were shopping via the AI agent had an average purchase size of over $200.
note: For payment firms, the Plaid connector is the detail to watch: Muse uses it to enable agentic shopping.

evidence.text: Meta said during its third-quarter earnings call on Wednesday that its AI app Muse has been adopted by more than 10 million users, confirming estimates released earlier this week by market intelligence firm Sensor Tower.
Zuckerberg said about 25% of people who set up Muse now use it daily, helping improve retention.
He also shared that over a quarter of Muse’s engaged users who were shopping via the AI agent, had an average purchase size of over $200, which was surprising even to industry insiders.
Muse uses Plaid’s connector to enable agentic shopping.
